requirement: Chat model picker exposes only operator-aliased models; a non-aliased deployment model cannot be selected

oracle.invariant: Enabling a deployment route for the backend does not expose it in the picker while its model_aliases is empty: routableProviders stays without that route. Once one model under the route is aliased, only that model appears under the route, renamed to its alias. selectModel of a non-aliased deployment model is refused with session/model-unavailable, including a wire-encoded tp_/tm_ id resolved against the host catalogue. modelLabels still resolves a now-hidden historical pick to its label.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: proxy reads current ops state and rejects stale picks before reaching dsh
tests: proxy reads current ops state and rejects stale picks before reaching dsh
